coaching.headline: Dominant win. The carry delivered; vision still needs work.
coaching.team: Murdock supplied the main damage while Wukong drove objective output and the squad took both recorded Fangtooths. The fighting and objective results earned the win, but the support vision contribution still needs to catch up; smashing faces is only part of the job.

focus.title: Give the objective setup a vision job
focus.action: Before the next major objective, the shot-caller should assign one teammate to clear the approach and another to cover them before the team starts it.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Wukong delivered kills and team-leading objective damage without dying. Keep the pressure and survival. Ward placement was thin, so add a safe ward on the exit route before the next commitment. Plan the way out as deliberately as the way in.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock carried the damage and kept deaths low. Keep that standard. In the next fight, hit the nearest safe target and leave enough room to respond when the enemy turns. Do not turn a strong carry game into a highlight hunt.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Scarlett contributed warding but no objective damage. Keep the vision and make the next post-fight job explicit: protect the approach or hit the objective. Tell the team which job is covered and follow through. Useful work should have a clear purpose.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Belica's early death to Bayle is the decision to review. Work out what made it possible and choose one concrete adjustment for the next match. Do that before touching the build. The shopping list is not a substitute for fixing a bad sequence.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Steel contributed to takedowns and led mitigation, but ward placement was sparse. Keep the fighting contribution and place available wards on safe objective approaches before the next setup. Check coverage with the team. Landing the engage does not tick every box on the support job.

9.1.call: The 9.1-minute kill cluster went 5-0; Fangtooth followed at 10:24. Item-count estimates do not establish an observed equipment deficit.

15.5.call: The 15.5-minute cluster went 3-0, followed by Fangtooth at 16:23. These are recorded results; attendance cannot be reconstructed from kill credit alone.

18.4.call: The final recorded cluster went 3-0. Missing tower timestamps prevent a structure-conversion verdict; the feed also does not establish that no objective was available.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Manta Scythe and Infernum were equipped. The lack-of-magic-resist flag alone does not demonstrate a build mistake, and no comparison core is available.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Lightning Hawk and Vanquisher match two comparison-core items. Estimated purchase timing is not evidence of an unusually early spike; the match does not establish a necessary swap.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Mutilator and Terminus differ from the comparison core. Neither the single death nor zero objective damage proves that the build caused a specific problem.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion and Wraith Leggings match two comparison-core items. The death record does not isolate an item problem; review the decision before prescribing a replacement.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Xenia and Dynamo accompanied strong takedown contribution and mitigation. Those results do not isolate their value or prove the alternative comparison core worse.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Steel's Eternal contribution is not modeled in this review; no effectiveness claim follows from these totals.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.5s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
enemyKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
enemyKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
enemyKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

enemyKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
enemyKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
enemyKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 1 time in 19 minutes, fewer deaths than about 92% of Murdock carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Murdock dealt 18,293 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +117 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Drongo (level 11: about 69 physical armor, 57 after penetration; took 7,605 physical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) and Argus (level 10: about 61 physical armor, 49 after penetration; took 8,703 physical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) that is about 8% and 8% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Loadout augment Justice's Reach: Shots Fired, the empowered shot after 5 basic attacks, pierces through units and reaches even further. Poke heroes standing behind their minion wave. (game text: Shots Fired now pierces units and has +250 additional range.) (changes Shots Fired) Field: 49.9% in 6501 games, 54% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout Eternal Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Murdock's basic-attack focus makes this a steady boost, best into tanks. (game text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 46.8% in 3648 games, 30% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout minor Serration: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs, helping finish hurt targets. (game text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 46.7% in 3409 games, 93% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout minor Melting Point: Extra damage only into enemies with over 125 physical armor. Buckshot's shred lowers their armor and can drop them below that line, so this is a pick into heavy tanks only. (game text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.) Field: 46.4% in 3424 games, 94% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout crest Pacifier: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger on targets below 20% health. Dash in and finish a low target with a basic attack or Buckshot. (game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 52.1% in 4624 games, 39% of picks, above the hero-role's 48.9%.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Pacifier, Vermis, Melting Point. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Vermis.

The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; every basic attack set off), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Murdock killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Drongo, Shinbi. We killed Murdock 1 time.
Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.3% in 3,251 Murdock carry games, below the hero's 48.9%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
